Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the honor and remember flag as Washington's emblem of the service and sacrifice by our military personnel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the honor and remember flag asWashington's emblem of the service and sacrifice by our militarypersonnel; adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act may be known and cited as the honorand remember flag act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The honor and remember flag created by Honor and Remember, Inc., isdesignated as the official Washington state emblem of the service andsacrifice by the brave men and women of the United States armed forceswho have given their lives in the line of duty.
